summary: In this excerpt from a fiction serial (Book 2, part 83), the narrator confronts a nondescript woman and her partner who have appeared with laser sights trained on the narrator and Tresting. The woman offers an alternative to coming with them, and the narrator counters by revealing that snipers are aimed at the group. The narrator then draws two guns and fires, the red dots vanish, and a brief violent fight breaks out in which Tresting knocks the woman out and the narrator kicks the man.
one_line: A tense standoff in Book 2 part 83 where the narrator and Tresting draw on laser-sighted captors and a brief fight erupts.
key_facts: A nondescript woman appears with an equally nondescript man right next to the narrator and their group.
The narrator asks the woman, "Laser sights? Really?" and says, "What is this, a cheesy action movie?"
The woman says the laser sights are "more for you than for our people" and an incentive to accompany them.
The woman says, "I'm sure it has been explained that we prefer not to kill you."
Tresting says, "We ain't coming, and if you try to force us, things will go bad for you people."
The narrator says "Tell your snipers to back off, and they get to live" after an additional laser dot joins the first on both Tresting and the narrator.
The narrator calculates wind speed and trajectories and works out that four laser dots correspond to four snipers' lines of sight.
The narrator slips back a step, draws from under the coat, and fires two shots with each hand, and the red dots disappear from the chests.
One of the passing hikers screams and pandemonium erupts.
Tresting gives the woman a vicious uppercut that drops her "like a sack of potatoes."
The narrator's right-hand gun fails to fire at the man, so the narrator kicks him in the face instead.
